name: Stitch Head
storyline: Stitch Head: Monster Merger Defenseis a mobile game where we combine merge puzzle mechanics and strategic tower defense gameplay, set within the beloved gothic world of Guy Bass's acclaimed book series. Launching strategically alongside the upcoming 2025 animated feature film, this mobile game transforms Castle Grotteskew into an interactive playground where players assume the role of Stitch Head, defending his home against fearful villagers through creative monster construction.
summary:
Welcome to Castle Grotteskew—where YOU are the last line of defense!

Step into the shoes of Stitch Head and defend your home against waves of fearful villagers in this spellbinding fusion of merge puzzles and tower defence strategy!
